title: fix(runtime)!: a same-origin `type: 'api'` action is dispatched through the action doors, so its packaged-action switch holds (#27506)
body:
domain:server#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgXcN9HaZYSEUdJWEjw

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuVpEmthvkRbuHGjC6oSQZvd)_

Fixes #27506

Ruling-ref: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/27506#issuecomment-6499781492 (Sales 「同意」 — option C in three steps; this PR is step 2, the server step).
Lands after #27610 (the ADR-0066 D4 / ADR-0126 §8 / spec-docblock text this behaviour rests on). Step 3 is #27611 (the console sends api clicks through this door).

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — no key, accepted value or export of `@objectstack/spec` changes. Two published runtime surfaces narrow for their consumers: `POST /actions/_activation/:object/:action` now refuses (409) to flip an off-origin `type: 'api'` action it accepted and recorded before, and the `headers` member of `@objectstack/runtime`'s `HttpDispatcherResult.response` is widened from `string` values to `string | string[]`, which a reader that assigned a value to a `string` no longer compiles against. An api action that reaches `POST /actions/:object/:action` or MCP `run_action` now passes the doors' gates (the sign-in floor, `requiredPermissions`, the activation switch, the param contract, the subject-row load) before its target runs, where the console's direct fetch passed none of them.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx` (the `type` table and the "Call it over REST" dispatch table) now state the same-origin forward and the off-origin refusal; no file under `skills/**` teaches that an api action is refused by the doors or invisible to MCP, so no skill line changes.

**BREAKING** at two published runtime surfaces (`@objectstack/runtime`).

- **The activation write door, `POST /api/v1/actions/_activation/:object/:action`.** *Before:* flipping a `type: 'api'` action whose `target` is on another origin was accepted and recorded as a ledger row, which nothing ever consulted — the switch read as set and did nothing. *Now:* that request is refused `409` (`error.code` `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`) with a message naming the origin and saying why (the browser calls that origin directly and this server never sees the request), and no row is written. Same-origin api actions, and every other action type, flip exactly as before. *Who sees it:* a Setup caller or script that switched an off-origin api action off and read the 2xx as "stopped". *The remedy:* none at the door — move the action's `target` onto this origin (a path starting with `/`) to make it switchable, or remove the action from the app; a script that treated the 2xx as success now reads the 409 reason.
- **The type `HttpDispatcherResult.response.headers`** (`packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts`). *Before:* `Record<string, string>`. *Now:* `Record<string, string | string[]>`; an array is one header line per element, and the `/actions` door emits one for `Set-Cookie`. *Who sees it:* an adapter or host outside this repository that reads the member and hands each value to a `string`-typed header setter (`error TS2345`). *The remedy, one line:* branch on `Array.isArray(value)` and emit each element as its own header line (Hono: `c.header(name, line, { append: true })`; Fetch `Headers`: `headers.append(name, line)`); joining the array with `, ` is NOT equivalent for `Set-Cookie`. The two in-repo adapters (`@objectstack/plugin-hono-server`, `@objectstack/hono`) ship that change in this release.

## What changed

Switching off a `type: 'api'` packaged action in the ADR-0126 §8 ledger did not stop it: the console fetched the action's `target` directly, the `/actions` door answered 400 for the type, and MCP `run_action` refused it outright — "Ban User switched off" still banned, and an agent could not do what a human click could.

- **Same-origin api actions are server-dispatched.** `POST /api/v1/actions/:object/:action` and MCP `run_action` accept a `type: 'api'` action whose `target` is a path on this origin. The door runs every gate it already runs — the sign-in floor, ADR-0066 D4 `requiredPermissions`, the ADR-0126 §8 activation consult, the param contract, the subject-row load — and then **forwards the request in-process** to the declared target (`IHttpServer.getRawApp()`'s request injector, the seam `@objectstack/verify` drives) with the caller's own credentials (`Authorization`, `Cookie`, `x-admin-session-token`, tenant and proxy headers) and the body assembled from the declaration by the console's own rules (`recordIdParam` / `recordIdField` from the subject row, refused by name when the row cannot supply it; `bodyShape.wrap`; the `outputs.*` fold; `organizationId` for an `/api/v1/auth/` target; `bodyExtra` last; `method`, no body on `DELETE`; `${param.*}` / `${ctx.recordId}` / `${ctx.user.id}` / `${ctx.org.id}` / `{field}` in the path). The target still authorizes the caller itself; its status and body are the door's answer (`data` unwrapped, as the console's direct fetch handed `result.data`), and a credential rotation it emits is relayed: on REST every `Set-Cookie` line plus `set-auth-token` / `set-admin-session-token`, so `impersonate_user` works through the door on the cookie lane and the bearer lane; over MCP only the bearer pair (`set-auth-token` / `set-admin-session-token`) — a `Set-Cookie` value never enters a tool result. The forward URL is built from the incoming `Host` alone (`x-forwarded-*` cross only as headers, for the target's own `trustProxy` reading), and a 2xx target answer that is not JSON is refused `502` (`EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR`) naming its content-type.
- **A disabled api action answers 409 `ACTION_DISABLED`** and its target is never called. A forwarded request that lands back on an action door is refused (400); a `${ctx.selection.*}` or `{{page.<var>}}` token (the console's own `{{page.*}}` grammar; any other `{{…}}` passes through literally) the server cannot resolve is refused 400 by name; a kernel with no in-process request path answers 503.
- **Off-origin api actions stay browser-only, and cannot be switched.** Both doors refuse them (400, naming the origin), MCP does not list them, and `POST /actions/_activation/:object/:action` refuses to flip them (409) with the reason — a ledger row nothing would consult is not recorded.
- **`HttpDispatcherResult.response.headers` accepts `string[]`** (one header line per element) and both in-repo Hono adapters append an array instead of comma-joining it (`@objectstack/plugin-hono-server`'s route `res.header`, and `@objectstack/hono`'s `toResponse` on its response, event-stream and raw-stream arms) — the only correct spelling for several `Set-Cookie` lines. Measured: `/admin/impersonate-user` answers six.

File surface beyond the claim's three (`action-execution.ts`, `domains/actions.ts`, `domains/mcp.ts`): `http-dispatcher.ts` (the header type, 1 line), `plugin-hono-server/src/adapter.ts` (the array append and the `Host` backfill) and `packages/adapters/hono/src/index.ts` with its new test `hono-response-header-array.test.ts` — all needed for the cookie lane; the probe before the red tests showed six `Set-Cookie` lines that a `Record<string, string>` channel could not carry. The pre-existing pin `http-dispatcher.actions-type-dispatch.test.ts` is rewritten to the new contract (forward through the injector; 503 without `http.server`), and `packages/runtime/test-typecheck-debt.json` shrinks that file's TS18048 row 24 → 22.

## Evidence

- Probe first (per the claim): in-process `app.request` to `/admin/ban-user`, `/admin/unban-user` and `/admin/impersonate-user` with the caller's bearer, and with the caller's cookie — all 200; `sys_user.banned` flips; impersonate answers 6 `Set-Cookie` + `set-auth-token` (+ `set-admin-session-token` on the bearer lane), and the caller's old bearer dies (#8243).
- Unit, `packages/runtime/src/domains/api-action-forward.test.ts` (new) + `action-activation-dispatch.test.ts` + `action-declarative-update.test.ts` + `action-execution-destructive.test.ts` (its "gate 2 excludes the 13 identity actions" pin flips to "gate 2 admits"): 128/128.
- Dogfood, `packages/qa/dogfood/test/api-action-door-forward.dogfood.test.ts` (new, real showcase + better-auth admin plugin + live MCP): ban_user off → 409 and not banned, on → banned; unban_user; set_user_password (the target signs in with the new password); a member's 403 relayed, anonymous 401; the off-origin flip refused 409 with no ledger row and the run refused 400; MCP `run_action` on a same-origin api action reaches the exposure gate instead of the type refusal; impersonate_user on the cookie lane (≥2 `Set-Cookie` lines, one per line) and the bearer lane (rotation headers, old token 401): 8/8.
- Ablation A (`isHeadlessInvokableAction`'s api arm → `false`): 17 red (both doors + the destructive pin), restored blob == HEAD. Ablation B (adapter array append → comma-join): the cookie-lane dogfood case red with the six cookies joined into one line, restored blob == HEAD.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` → 112 families (93 for the diff + 19 the `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` ledger edit adds); every command run with its exit captured before any pipe; `--ran` reconciliation: 112 derived, 112 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Four prerequisites cleared and re-run to 0 (teardown-shape self-test after `git fetch --unshallow`; dual-build-cjs-loads and skill-examples after building the 8 dists the closure leaves out); two findings fixed in-branch (ADR-0087 disposition marker on the changeset; the route-envelope ledger now declares `actions.ts` handBuilt 3 — the 405 and the forward's two header-carrying answers).
- Dogfood battery on the final head: final-closure head f4245047 (merge of origin/main 9c513147 onto the fix; the two later commits 80fc341a / 75d7d9e1 change only the changeset text and the route-envelope ledger script) · os-verify-lock VERDICT command-exit 0 · held 35m38s · Test Files 352 passed | 3 skipped (355) · Tests 2830 passed | 20 skipped (2850) · 0 failures.

## 维护者速读(席位终稿)

- 改了什么：同源 `type: 'api'` 动作改为经 `/actions` 门与 MCP `run_action` 派发：过完现有各闸后在进程内转发到声明的 `target`，请求体按控制台规则在服务端组装，调用方凭据带过去，目标的 Set-Cookie / 令牌轮换带回来；外站 api 动作两门仍拒、写入门拒绝切换并说明原因；响应头通道支持多值。
- 为什么改：#27506 关掉「封禁用户」照样封禁——api 动作从不经过激活判定；裁决 C（6499781492）要求人和 agent 走同一扇门。
- 风险与回滚：**破坏性**两处——写入门对外站 api 动作的切换改为 409（原先 200 且记账但不生效）；`HttpDispatcherResult.response.headers` 放宽为 `string | string[]`（外部适配器一行修法见 BREAKING 段）。MCP 只回传 bearer 令牌对，Set-Cookie 不进工具结果。控制台直调不受影响直到 #27611；回滚即 revert 本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts` 的 `buildApiActionRequest` / `forwardApiAction`，`domains/actions.ts` 的 api 分支与写入门 3b，`plugin-hono-server/src/adapter.ts` 的数组追加。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/api-action-door-forward.dogfood.test.ts`（需先 build 闭包）。
- 需要你做的：先合 #27610（Tier H，ADR 文本），席位随后把本 PR 转 ready 入队；#27611 等本 PR。MCP 对 sys_* 动作的拒绝另立 #27681 待裁。

席位意见：契约复核两轮（75d7d9e1 FAIL → a87722dd PASS，记录 6504462099），三条必改与六条应改均在树上修复并有钉；建议在 #27610 合并后落地。
